title: Technical Service and Field Application Engineer
desc:
We are looking for a "Technical Service and Field Application Engineer" for our customer
Perform installation, commissioning, and maintenance of process instrumentation, automation devices, and systems
Design and manufacture tailored electrical control panels
Provide technical support on-site or remotely to customers
Diagnose, repair, and calibrate equipment
Prepare service reports and maintain customer documentation
Deliver training to customer staff on product usage, maintenance, and safety
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance programs under service contracts
Collaborate with the sales team to provide technical solutions
Share field feedback with product and engineering teams
Record all activities, and feedback in CRM tools, and generate reports
Travel domestically and internationally as required
Bachelor’s degree in
electrical / electronics
or related fields
3–5 years
of experience in industrial automation, process instrumentation, or field service
Solid knowledge of electronics, automation, and instrumentation
Proficiency in SCADA and PLC software (preferably Codesys, TIA Portal, and WinCC) as well as programming languages such as C++, Python, and JavaScript
Skilled in electrical panel design and EPLAN project drawings
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
Customer-oriented mindset with strong communication abilities
Proficiency in MS Office applications
Good command of English (capable of reading technical documents and communicating with customers)
Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel
